newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Sept retail sales up 0.6 pct, 27.2 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Sept retail sales up 0.6 pct, 27.2 pct y/y.

text.p: Croatia's retail sales, boosted by footwear and leather sales, rose 0.6 percent in September from August and 27.2 percent compared to the same month last year, the State Statistics Bureau reported on Tuesday.
Figures for the first nine months of 1996 showed retail sales up 17.7 percent from a year ago period.
The steepest monthly rise of 70.2 percent was recorded in footwear, leather, rubber and plastic products while the sales of cars and spare parts shrank most by 32.6 percent.
Retailers' September stocks were 4.1 percent higher, with milk stocks up 40.6 percent from August. They shrank 1.3 percent from September 1995.
The September monthly retail prices rose 0.1 percent after being flat in August. The year-on-year inflation stood at 1.9 percent.
